name: blockchain-research
description: Multi-chain blockchain protocol and on-chain indexing research. Ships three chain-specific skills: blockchain-research:ethereum-researcher (go-ethereum, reth, revm, prysm, forkcast, EIPs), blockchain-research:solana-researcher (solana, agave, SPL, Anchor, Geyser), blockchain-research:tempo-researcher (tempo, tempo-go, mpp-go, mpp-rs, tidx, TIP-20, MPP, Simplex BFT). Each skill covers protocol analysis plus indexing concerns (reorg / finality, asset standards, RPC / gRPC, protocol-level transfers, event / ABI / IDL decoding, transaction envelopes, state access / commitment / archive) for the target chain and produces structured reports via the plugin-level shared MD / HTML templates with Mermaid and inline SVG visualizations. Use the relevant chain skill whenever the user is investigating that chain, even if they just ask 'how does X work' without the word 'research'.
